title: Pushable Budding Amethyst
description: This mod makes Budding Amethyst blocks pushable by pistons
body:
# Pushable Budding Amethyst

This mod allows you to push Budding Amethyst blocks with pistons.

![Example image showing Budding Amethyst before and after being pushed by a piston](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c0ac64a44ff62e1f02e63a83d332b37f68e97c94.png)

The implementation is simply taken from Gnembon's Carpet mod ([Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/carpet) | [Github](https://github.com/gnembon/fabric-carpet)). Carpet mod adds a custom
gamerule to allow for the same functionality (`/carpet movableAmethyst true`). However that
same rule also allows the player to mine Budding Amethyst blocks using a Silk Touch pickaxe.
As I don't like that part of the rule, I separated out just the pushing functionality into its
own mod.

There is also an [earlier mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/pushable-amethysts) by [clearKeep](https://codeberg.org/clearKeep) which does the same thing for older Minecraft versions (1.20 - 1.20.2).
